items.fit: Developers with Hedera and smart-contract experience; or community professionals in marketing, education, UX/UI or project management.
items.work: Run technical workshops, make technical content, support developers, organize events, build partnerships or make community content.
items.reward: Certificates, swag and badges. Cash or token amount not stated.
items.safety: Open the linked form from Hedera’s official page. No crypto payment request was found on the page.

items.fit: People aged 18+ interested in blockchain education, security and community building. Prior experience is suggested, not required.
items.work: Host events, share educational content, support newcomers and connect academic communities.
items.reward: Mentorship, experience, recognition, resources and merchandise. Cash pay not stated.
items.selection: Application; the site says review and reply in 5–7 business days, with a possible interview.
items.safety: Use the Typeform only from Cyfrin’s official page. SSCD+ certification is required within six weeks after onboarding to continue.

items.fit: Experienced people with local crypto and marketing contacts, public-speaking confidence and B2B sales experience.
items.work: Build partnerships, make content, represent Nexo at events, use affiliate-led growth, reach media and localize content.
items.reward: Nexo says competitive salary and result-based incentives. Amount, targets, timing and jurisdiction terms are not stated.
items.selection: Public form asks why and how you can contribute; later steps are not stated.
items.safety: The form requests phone and LinkedIn information. Read privacy terms before submitting.

items.fit: Community builders, active Aster users or traders, and people with a track record of community work.
items.work: Host meetups, workshops, AMAs or trading sessions; onboard users; give product feedback.
items.reward: Event support up to $5,000 per event, toolkit, merchandise, promotion and early product access. Aster says there is no direct salary.
items.selection: Application; Aster says it reviews applicants within two weeks and may invite qualified candidates to a screening call.
items.safety: The role can involve futures, perpetuals and high-leverage trading education. No fee to become an ambassador is stated.

items.fit: People with strong interpersonal and communication skills; some roles expect knowledge of Elk products.
items.work: Community work, content, events, partnerships, translation, design or development.
items.reward: The selected apprentice works as a volunteer during the trial. Post-trial benefits and their value are not stated.
items.selection: Application, then an interview subject to qualification, then a trial period.
items.safety: The official page links a hosted application. Do not assume post-trial benefits are paid compensation.

items.fit: Creators and community contributors willing to make content, engage users and organize promotion.
items.work: Make posts, videos or articles; join discussions; help with events and campaigns; promote referrals.
items.reward: 30% of minting fees from referrals and 30% off Score minting. The unit, payout timing and other conditions are not stated.
items.selection: Sign-up form; review process is not stated.
items.safety: This is a contributor role with referral-linked rewards, not a stated wage or stipend.

items.fit: People with 500+ social followers or a 100+ member community, plus substantial trading experience.
items.work: Bring people to Bitget and promote spot, futures, CFDs, RWAs and trading promotions; share trading strategies.
items.reward: Access to a $50,000 promotion pool, support fund, rebates up to 50% and bonus credits. Individual award amounts are not stated.
items.selection: Bitget says applications are reviewed within seven working days; existing affiliates and direct referrals are ineligible.
items.safety: This is a trading-community growth campaign, not a general contributor role. Verify any Telegram contact is an official Bitget account.

items.fit: Community contributors; Soneium highlights the US, Japan, Korea and China.
items.work: Onboard users, answer community questions, host meetups, guide people through apps and support builders.
items.reward: Recognition, resources, approved activation support and possible merch or community rewards. Cash amount not stated.
items.selection: The announcement says it reviews background, Soneium history, community experience, location, availability and fit.
items.safety: The official June announcement still links a hosted form, but its current acceptance and fields could not be inspected. Do not treat the link alone as proof submissions are accepted.

items.fit: 18+ undergraduates graduating after Dec 2026, available 4–6 hours weekly, and not formal ambassadors for a competing chain or company.
items.work: Four workshops per semester, weekly build nights and a demo day.
items.reward: USDC semester stipend in milestone-based installments; amount not stated.
items.selection: Two 60-second videos and short answers. The page says it reviews every application.
items.safety: The page still shows form fields, but the published close date has passed.

items.fit: Contributors with content, outreach, events or community skills who have a referral.
items.work: Advocacy, content, outreach, events, mentoring and local or global initiatives.
items.reward: Not stated on the inspected program page.
items.selection: The official page says positions are referrals only and asks applicants to name their referrer.
items.people: A May 2026 forum reply from a program representative said there were 13 funded contributors and three mentors unpaid. It is a program response, not pay proof.
items.safety: This is not general open access. Confirm the referrer rule before submitting.

items.fit: For a future reopening; applications are closed now.
items.work: Social conversation, content, feedback and community activity.
items.reward: The page describes a $200 monthly crypto base reward, with $10 or $15 X-impression rewards subject to review; not available to new applicants now.
items.selection: Not applicable while applications are closed.
items.safety: Follow the official account only for a reopening. Do not treat listed reward terms as a current offer.
